messages:
Ellie: Free pickup in SF office — I have a standing desk converter (36x24in, black, ~12in lift), plus 2x SXSW day badges for Friday I can't use, and an HDMI 2.1 cable. First come, first served. Can drop off at 2pm today or pick up anytime tomorrow. Photos: https://imgur.com/a/desk-photo :raised_hands:
Tao: omg the badges? :eyes: what time is the 2pm dropoff? I might be able to swing by during lunch
Ellie: 2pm lobby pickup, I'll be at desk near kitchen. The converter is in great shape, no wobble. Badges are digital transfer codes. HDMI is unopened.
Maria: Interested in the desk if Tao skips. Could you share model or weight limit?
Ellie: It's a generic converter (fits double monitor stand), rated ~40 lbs. Dimensions in case: `36"x24"`, lift ~12". No screws needed.
Jon: I'll take the HDMI if it's still there — need for my PS5 setup. Can Venmo for shipping? :smile:
Ellie: HDMI is free but if you want to cover small shipping cost that's fine. Venmo @ellie-rw.
Devin: I can take one SXSW badge if Tao passes. Willing to swap a spare monitor stand I have (single-arm monitor mount) if that helps.
Tao: Heads up I can't do 2pm anymore, sorry. Devin, want the badge? Devin: yup please.
Ellie: OK — desk -> Maria, HDMI -> Jon, SXSW badge -> Devin (1 of 2), second badge up for grabs. If someone wants both badges DM me and I'll transfer codes.
ops-bot: Reminder: office pickups must be logged with frontdesk.ellie (cal) for after-hours access.
Maria: I'll pick up at 11am tomorrow then. Can you leave it labeled at the front desk?
Ellie: Yep, I'll leave a note and put it by the concierge with your name. Thanks all! :sparkles:
Jon: Thanks! HDMI pickup at 2:10? I'll swing by after standup.
Devin: DM'ing you now for badge transfer :)
Ellie: Done. Leaving desk at front desk under "Maria". Badge codes sent to Devin. HDMI reserved for Jon. If anything falls through I'll update here. :party_parrot:
